name: Greptile TREX
desc: Review mode that writes and runs tests in a sandbox.
desc_zh: 在沙箱里为你的改动写测试并跑起来的审查模式。
solves: A reviewer can read a diff but cannot see whether the feature still works; TREX starts the app and exercises it like a user.
solves_zh: 审查者能读 diff，却看不出功能是否还能用；TREX 会把应用跑起来，像用户一样操作一遍。
best_for: A pull request changes behaviour that no existing test covers.
best_for_zh: 某个 Pull Request 改了行为，而现有测试完全没覆盖到。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — greptile.com/changelog directory）。 Public beta at launch; became generally available on 2026-10-16. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「TREX」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.greptile.com/changelog
